reviewRemediation.finding: MEDIUM weak claim-to-fixture test: test_registered_claims_match_the_retained_fixture_bytes computed the exact decoded lengths and direction labels but asserted only an aggregate string, a count string and a path prefix, so a claim could have been repointed, reordered or widened without failing.
reviewRemediation.result: Replaced the aggregate checks with an exact total mapping in claim_mapping_failures(): each of BARRIER-EVID-0001-CLAIM-001/002/003 must establish exactly its intended establishedFieldIds and point at exactly its intended fixture JSON pointers, including all seven observation payload pointers in observed order and the two whole-observations pointers; every pointer is resolved with an RFC 6901 resolver and must resolve to the exact payload it names; the retained sequence must be contiguous and 1-based; the per-run decoded lengths must appear in observed order followed by their aggregate; no established identifier may be shared between claims; and coverage.direction must match the observed label set against entryContract.directions. No prose is parsed for meaning and no protocol semantics is added. test_claim_mapping_rejects_a_fixture_or_claim_that_drifts adds twelve mutations and requires each to be rejected.

reviewRemediation.finding: LOW overbroad network statement: transport.networkScope asserted 'no wider network path was used' although the observation was reached through an encrypted local forward.
reviewRemediation.result: Rewritten to record what the recorder observed: it ran on the peer loopback interface and observed the Barrier leg there only, every retained byte comes from that peer-loopback observation, and the wider transport leg was an encrypted local forward whose contents the recorder did not capture, so no cleartext Barrier payload was observed or retained outside the peer-loopback leg and nothing is claimed about that encrypted leg. A matching limitation was added and the register documentation and summary.md were aligned. No endpoint identifier is introduced. Verified by test_transport_scope_records_only_the_observed_peer_loopback_leg, which rejects the old blanket wording and any IPv4 literal, IPv6-style token, :port suffix or host name.
